cavityRootCause.exactCause: The visible SHOT_02 south waterline was a ~0.6 m shoulder terrace (terrain at BED_SHOULDER_Z while the film sat at -1.15), so Camera C saw a dark vertical face and a hollow under the lip. AUTO bezier handles also drifted the water film off the polyline carve at the (-2,-12) bend.
cavityRootCause.exactFix: VECTOR handles so film follows the polyline; shared hero_south_water_factor; TJ_HeroBankSolid reduced to an under-film wet lip; hero south bank rebuilt as a continuous ramp that meets the film at water height. Pixels still show at least one leftover void.

shotAssessments.SHOT_01: Valley establish preserved. Large tilted Grass01 cards are gone. Meadow still reads as one displaced green plane; earth patches and upright tufts do not survive 540 px from the high camera.
shotAssessments.SHOT_02: Camera C creek-first and Louis sky preserved. Hero rocks are now visible as foreground masses, but the grass/water isoline is still followable and at least one dark waterline cavity remains.
shotAssessments.SHOT_03: West-grove forest passage preserved. Cabin absent.
shotAssessments.SHOT_05: 120 mm pines-against-Louis preserved. Hero peak placement unchanged.
shotAssessments.SHOT_06: Tree-framed scenic payoff preserved. Distinct from 03 and 05.
